eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k cc248372-f777-458c-b720-a949e5d692eb 61e1f2ae-b1d8-4691-838e-2d245d6546d7 fit verb ˈfɪt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/f/fit00001.wav no obj [usually + in]
to belong in a particular situation, place, or group 属于某种特定的情境、地点或群体 It's a good school, but I feel like I just don't fit here. 这是一所好学校，但我觉得自己在这里格格不入。 I was looking for a group that I could fit in with. 我一直在寻找一个我可以融入的群体。 No matter how hard she tried, she just didn't fit in. 无论她多么努力，她就是无法融入其中。 He fit right in at school.
That chair fits in well with the rest of the office. 他很快就融入了学校。
那把椅子和办公室的其他家具很搭。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 55036655-5fce-440e-859d-9852310e0d4b 61e1f2ae-b1d8-4691-838e-2d245d6546d7 fit verb ˈfɪt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/f/fit00001.wav to be suitable or appropriate for (someone or something) 适合（某人或某事）；对……合适 The nickname fits [=suits] him very well. 这个绰号非常适合他。 The punishment should fit the crime. 惩罚应与罪行相称。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k de498c5b-2dfe-45bf-89e3-31194239e8ec 61e1f2ae-b1d8-4691-838e-2d245d6546d7 fit verb ˈfɪt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/f/fit00001.wav to make (someone or something) suitable or appropriate for or to something 使（某人或某物）适合或适应某事或某物 Her previous experience fitted [=qualified] her for the job. 她以前的经验使她有资格胜任这份工作。 Let us fit the punishment to the crime. 让我们让惩罚与罪行相匹配。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 74ca8652-9d90-4f7c-a2a6-4f29e3103880 61e1f2ae-b1d8-4691-838e-2d245d6546d7 fit verb ˈfɪt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/f/fit00001.wav + obj, not used in progressive tenses to be in agreement with (something or someone) 与（某事或某人）一致 Their story doesn't fit the facts. 他们的说法与事实不符。 He fits [=matches] the description perfectly. = The description fits him perfectly. 他完全符合这个描述。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 0f778f5e-7f8a-4fdf-9c75-248f2fcee926 61e1f2ae-b1d8-4691-838e-2d245d6546d7 fit verb ˈfɪt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/f/fit00001.wav + obj [often + out or up]
to supply equipment for (something) 为（某物）提供设备 a lab fitted with the latest equipment 配备了最新设备的实验室 The camera can be fitted with many different lenses. 该相机可以配备多种不同的镜头。 fit out an expedition 装备一次探险 an old ocean liner fitted up as a hospital ship 一艘被改装为医院船的老式远洋班轮 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 03710ff3-a881-4f36-a16c-75c7a5c3cca2 d1a3d9b9-4f85-41b0-bae0-848ad7cda559 claim noun ˈkleɪm https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/claim001.wav count a statement saying that something happened a certain way or will happen a certain way a statement saying that something is true when some people may say it is not true 一份声明，说明某件事情以某种方式发生了，或者将以某种方式发生；一份声明，说明某件事情是真的，尽管有些人可能会说这不是真的。 She makes the claim that sea levels will actually go down. 她声称海平面实际上会下降。 He made false claims about his past job experience. 他对自己的过往工作经历做出了虚假陈述。 The book makes some extravagant claims. [=it includes statements that many people will not agree with] 这本书提出了一些夸张的主张。 She disputes/denies the claim [=she says it isn't true] that she was unfaithful to her husband.
I make no claim to be an expert. [=I don't say that I am an expert] 她对有人指责她对丈夫不忠提出异议/予以否认。
我并不自称是专家。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 959bd4b1-4f13-4e6b-8230-9a198a6bfdb9 d1a3d9b9-4f85-41b0-bae0-848ad7cda559 claim noun ˈkleɪm https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/claim001.wav count an official request for something (such as money) that is owed to you or that you believe is owed to you 对某事（例如你应得的钱或你认为应得的钱）提出的正式请求 You'll need to file an insurance claim to pay for the damage. 你需要提交保险理赔来支付损坏费用。 make a claim on your insurance policy 对您的保险单提出索赔 All claims must be made in writing. 所有索赔必须以书面形式提出。 Please fill out this claim form. [=a document with information about why you should be given money] 请填写此理赔表。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 1c8bc85c-32fb-4c66-8e94-82f8aba9492b d1a3d9b9-4f85-41b0-bae0-848ad7cda559 claim noun ˈkleɪm https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/claim001.wav count [usually + on or to] [To lay claim to (something) is to say that it belongs to you or that you have a right to it.]
a right to have something 拥有某物的权利 The bank has a claim on/to their house and land. 银行对他们的房屋和土地拥有债权。 The book would have little claim on our attention if not for the fact that its story is true. 如果不是因为这个故事是真实的，这本书几乎不会引起我们的注意。 the family's claim to the name 该家族对这个名字的主张 She laid claim to the ring.
The community lays claim to (the honor of) being the oldest city in the country. [=it claims to be the oldest city in the country] 她声称拥有这枚戒指的所有权。
该社区声称（拥有）全国最古老城市的荣誉。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 7bf830fc-9514-4311-969b-a94bdd9e10cd d1a3d9b9-4f85-41b0-bae0-848ad7cda559 claim noun ˈkleɪm https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/claim001.wav count an area of land that you take as your own often for a specified use 一块你占为己有的土地，通常用于特定用途 a mining/timber claim 采矿/伐木权利要求 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 14d53542-f233-4653-bd91-b438c54f072e f2d31945-03f9-4a6e-ac83-921f3c90eb4b cry verb ˈkraɪ https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cry00001.wav [If you cry yourself to sleep, you cry until you have fallen asleep.]
to produce tears from your eyes often while making loud sounds because of pain, sorrow, or other strong emotions 因为疼痛、悲伤或其他强烈情感而经常从眼中流泪，通常还会发出很大的声音。 The baby is crying. Is she okay? 婴儿在哭。她还好吗？ a crying baby 一个正在哭泣的婴儿 Some people cry more easily than others. 有些人比其他人更容易哭泣。 He cried silently while the song played.
She cried all the way home from school that day.
He cried (for) the whole day.
She couldn't imagine why anyone would cry over a stupid movie.
She was crying with relief/frustration/anger.
The first day of camp, a number of children cried for their parents. [=cried because they wanted their parents]
They cried tears of joy.
[If you cry your eyes out or cry your heart out, you cry a lot.] I cried my eyes out when I found out they had left without saying goodbye. 当歌曲播放时，他默默地哭了。
那天她从学校一路哭着回家。
他哭了一整天。
她无法想象为什么有人会为一部愚蠢的电影哭泣。
她因如释重负/沮丧/愤怒而哭泣。
夏令营的第一天，许多孩子哭着想父母。
他们流下了喜悦的泪水。
当我发现他们没有道别就离开时，我哭得稀里哗啦。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 074ec114-e50b-47f1-b318-09421f992722 f2d31945-03f9-4a6e-ac83-921f3c90eb4b cry verb ˈkraɪ https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cry00001.wav [often + for] [sometimes used figuratively]
to shout or say something loudly 大声喊叫或说某事 “We've won!” they cried. “我们赢了！”他们喊道。 “Help,” he cried, “Get a doctor! Quick!” “救命，”他喊道，“快叫医生！快！” I heard someone cry “Wait!” but the train pulled away anyway. 我听到有人喊“等一下！”，但火车还是开走了。 She cried [=called out] to the others to come and see what she'd found.
I heard someone crying for help.
Various groups have been crying for [=calling for] his resignation. 她喊叫着让其他人过来看她发现了什么。
我听到有人在呼救。
各个团体一直在呼吁他辞职。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k f444f692-7f76-4bf0-b418-eaf9d5ca081c f2d31945-03f9-4a6e-ac83-921f3c90eb4b cry verb ˈkraɪ https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cry00001.wav no obj, of a bird or animal to make the loud sound that is usual for a particular type of bird or animal 发出某种特定鸟类或动物通常会发出的响亮声音 She'd never heard the sound of sea gulls crying by the shore. 她从未听过海鸥在海岸边鸣叫的声音。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k e6d1d8a6-0687-4f3d-af1e-06851bb17bab 8f31a7d0-cf21-4272-87bd-3f3d454fed21 equipment noun ɪˈkwɪpmənt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/e/equipm01.wav noncount supplies or tools needed for a special purpose 为特殊用途所需的用品或工具 sports/stereo/laboratory equipment 体育/立体声/实验室设备 The photographer came early to set up his equipment. 摄影师早早地来到现场，准备好他的设备。 I'm looking for a hobby that doesn't require a lot of fancy equipment. 我正在寻找一种不需要很多高级设备的爱好。 an expensive piece of medical equipment 一台昂贵的医疗设备 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 44b7607d-98ef-4a7a-8a12-e39b0f6db693 8f31a7d0-cf21-4272-87bd-3f3d454fed21 equipment noun ɪˈkwɪpmənt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/e/equipm01.wav noncount the act of equipping someone or something 为某人或某物配备装备的行为 Not enough funds were provided for the equipment of the troops. 没有为部队的装备提供足够的资金。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k c01397ad-67d6-4b65-ac7d-fd5f7401f882 caa2348f-5c67-437e-a2fd-2d653761478c worth preposition ˈwɚθ https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/w/worth001.wav used to indicate the value of something 用于表示某物的价值 a ruby worth five million dollars 一颗价值五百万美元的红宝石 This painting is worth a fortune. 这幅画价值连城。 You should be paid what your labor is worth. 你应该得到与你的劳动价值相符的报酬。 Each correct answer is worth five points. 每个正确答案得五分。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 035a6a98-38da-4961-b42f-06450c484a07 caa2348f-5c67-437e-a2fd-2d653761478c worth preposition ˈwɚθ https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/w/worth001.wav having money and possessions equal in value to (an amount) 拥有与（某个数额）等值的钱和财产 an actor worth several million dollars 一位身价数百万美元的演员 The corporation is worth billions of dollars. 这家公司价值数十亿美元。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 2532330d-051a-4b77-ad0e-51d157cba730 caa2348f-5c67-437e-a2fd-2d653761478c worth preposition ˈwɚθ https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/w/worth001.wav good, valuable, or important enough for (something) deserving of (something) 足够好、有价值或重要，值得（某事）；应得（某事） A carefully written cover letter and resume is worth the effort. 精心撰写的求职信和简历是值得付出努力的。 It takes a long time to get a table at the restaurant, but the food is well worth the wait. 在这家餐厅等位需要很长时间，但食物绝对值得等待。 The movie was good, but I didn't think it was worth all the fuss/hype. 这部电影还不错，但我觉得它不值得这么多的关注/炒作。 It's worth a try. = It's worth trying.
Chicago is worth a visit. I think you'll really like it.
Do you think the car is worth buying?
It is worth noting/mentioning that his father and mother are also doctors.
This book is not worth reading.
an idea well worth consideration
Going to college was worth every penny.
This contract isn't worth the paper it's written/printed on. [=this contract has no real value; this contract is not legally valid]
I promise that speaking with her will be worth your while. [=speaking with her will be a good/useful thing for you to do]
I had to sacrifice all of my free time to make this film, but in the end, it was all worth it.
The repairs cost a lot of money, but they were worth it.
It's not worth fixing the car. = It's not worth it to fix the car. = The car is not worth fixing. 值得一试。
芝加哥值得一游。我觉得你会非常喜欢那里。
你觉得这辆车值得买吗？
值得注意/提及的是，他的父母也是医生。
这本书不值得读。
一个非常值得考虑的想法
上大学的每一分钱都很值得。
这份合同连写/打印在纸上的纸都不值。
我保证和她谈话会让你不虚此行。
为了拍这部电影，我不得不牺牲了所有的空闲时间，但最终，一切都值得。
修理花了很多钱，但很值得。
修这辆车不值得。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 901b9dbe-dd9f-4540-b96e-22ac18b6dbb3 a0cb476b-dc9a-473f-b067-2d108e33d0cb associate verb əˈsoʊʃiˌeɪt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/a/associ01.wav + obj [usually + with] [When one thing is associated with another, they happen together or are related or connected in some way.]
to think of one person or thing when you think of another person or thing 当你想到一个人或事物时，会联想到另一个人或事物。 I associate flowers with spring. 我把花和春天联系在一起。 She will always associate that place with her youth. 她将永远把那个地方与她的青春联系在一起。 People associate the company with televisions but it also makes computers. 人们把这家公司与电视联系在一起，但它也生产电脑。 There are several dangers/risks associated with [=connected with] that approach.
plants associated with the desert
He has symptoms associated with lung disease.
There are health problems that are often associated with poverty. 那种方法存在若干危险/风险。
与沙漠相关的植物
他有与肺部疾病相关的症状。
有些健康问题常常与贫困相关。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k d10c4e9e-52a1-4cec-bdc7-33a49ea9f45d a0cb476b-dc9a-473f-b067-2d108e33d0cb associate verb əˈsoʊʃiˌeɪt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/a/associ01.wav to be together with another person or group as friends, partners, etc. 与另一个人或团体作为朋友、伙伴等在一起。 She associates with [=is friends with] some pretty strange people. 她和一些非常奇怪的人交往。 They denied associating with terrorists. [=they denied being involved with terrorists] 他们否认与恐怖分子有联系。 He was associated [=connected, identified] with a group of radicals in the government. 他与政府中的一群激进分子有联系。 I no longer wish to be associated with people like him.
She associates herself with some pretty strange people.
[If you associate yourself with something, such as a political movement, you show or say that you support and agree with it.] He was reluctant to associate himself with the government's position. 我不再希望与像他那样的人有任何关联。
她与一些相当奇怪的人为伍。
他不愿意与政府的立场挂钩。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k dfd6c35b-4cba-4533-9192-520e06dffb6a e2979845-0cb9-47b7-b16c-1768a53e0d13 critic noun ˈkrɪtɪk https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/critic01.wav count a person who gives opinions about books, movies, or other forms of art 对书籍、电影或其他艺术形式发表意见的人 a film/theater/art critic 电影/戏剧/艺术评论家 He is an influential literary critic. 他是一位有影响力的文学评论家。 Critics praised the book. 评论家们称赞了这本书。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k 40fc57aa-8775-488d-ab70-3ae23075db6c e2979845-0cb9-47b7-b16c-1768a53e0d13 critic noun ˈkrɪtɪk https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/critic01.wav count a person who disapproves of someone or something a person who criticizes someone or something 一个不赞同某人或某事的人，一个批评某人或某事的人 Critics of the new law say that it will not reduce crime. 新法律的批评者表示，这项法律不会减少犯罪。 The actor had to answer many charges from his critics. 这位演员不得不回应许多来自批评者的指责。 He is a fierce/loud/outspoken critic of tax reform. 他是税制改革的激烈/高声/直言不讳的批评者。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::02k d66956d6-a871-425a-822d-dd78fea254e0 1254ffef-2ce8-40e8-84b5-85c468d80832 warm adjective ˈwoɚm https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/w/warm0001.wav somewhat hot not cool or cold 有点热，不凉也不冷 Be sure to keep warm when you go outside. 外出时一定要注意保暖。 warm weather 温暖的天气 a warm fire/radiator 温暖的火炉/暖气片 I'm feeling warm.
We sat by the fire to stay warm.
It's too warm in here. We should open a window. 我觉得很暖和。
